events.title: The financial crisis intensifies
events.description: Lehman Brothers files for bankruptcy. Authorities support other financial firms as stress spreads.

events.title: Deepwater Horizon disaster
events.description: An offshore drilling explosion kills workers and leads to a major oil spill.

events.title: Japan is struck by an earthquake and tsunami
events.description: Coastal communities suffer devastating damage and begin a long recovery.

what_happened_next.text: Apple grew to almost five times its starting value. Disney also gained, but the international basket lost more than one-fifth. The US basket ended only slightly higher, close to cash. A new device could be a major business opportunity without making every investment in the same period successful.

reflection.what_people_were_focused_on: Touchscreens and the iPhone attracted attention, while Disney changed direction and communities faced political and economic uncertainty.
reflection.what_actually_mattered: The different paths mattered. A broad foreign basket and a US basket did not move alike, and one highly successful company outpaced both.
reflection.what_faded_away: A memorable product demonstration did not reveal the size of future returns. It also did not remove the risks of owning a single share.
reflection.what_nobody_knew: The financial crisis was still ahead. Even someone excited about the iPhone could not know its full business effect or the investment path.
